findings.title: NVD record for CVE-2025-59718 (Fortinet FG-IR-25-647)
findings.summary_md: Improper verification of cryptographic signature in FortiOS 7.0.0 through 7.0.17, 7.2.0 through 7.2.11, 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, 7.6.0 through 7.6.3, FortiProxy 7.0.0 through 7.0.21, 7.2.0 through 7.2.14, 7.4.0 through 7.4.10, 7.6.0 through 7.6.3, and FortiSwitchManager allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass FortiCloud SSO login authentication via a crafted SAML response. CVSS 9.8. The Fortinet advisory FG-IR-25-647 also covers twin CVE-2025-59719, which affects FortiWeb 7.4.0 through 7.4.9, 7.6.0 through 7.6.4, and 8.0.0.

findings.title: Arctic Wolf observes malicious SSO logins on FortiGate devices following disclosure of CVE-2025-59718 and CVE-2025-59719
findings.summary_md: Arctic Wolf began observing intrusions involving malicious SSO logins on FortiGate appliances on December 12, 2025, three days after Fortinet's disclosure of the FortiCloud SSO signature verification bypass. This is early exploitation telemetry showing the FortiCloud SSO attack path was in use months before FortiBleed surfaced publicly in June 2026.

findings.title: CISA adds CVE-2025-59718 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
findings.summary_md: CISA added CVE-2025-59718 to KEV on December 16, 2025, one week after publication, citing FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb. The entry describes the improper verification of cryptographic signature that allows an unauthenticated FortiCloud SSO login bypass via a crafted SAML message.

findings.title: Fortinet PSIRT blog: Analysis of Single Sign-On Abuse on FortiOS
findings.summary_md: Fortinet published vendor analysis of single sign-on abuse on FortiOS, proactively communicating to customers about the issue. The post appeared in January 2026, five months before the FortiBleed leak brought the credential campaign to public attention.

findings.title: NVD record for CVE-2026-24858 (Fortinet FG-IR-26-060)
findings.summary_md: Authentication bypass using an alternate path in FortiAnalyzer 7.0.0 through 7.0.15, 7.2.0 through 7.2.11, 7.4.0 through 7.4.9, 7.6.0 through 7.6.5, FortiManager, FortiOS, and FortiProxy allows an attacker with a FortiCloud account and one registered device to log into devices registered to other accounts where FortiCloud SSO authentication is enabled. CVSS 9.8, advisory FG-IR-26-060. CISA listed it in KEV the same day.

findings.title: CISA adds CVE-2026-24858 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
findings.summary_md: CISA added CVE-2026-24858 to KEV on January 27, 2026, its publication date, for the FortiCloud SSO cross-account authentication bypass affecting FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, FortiOS, and FortiProxy. Same-day KEV listing indicates confirmed exploitation from the start.
